name: Ninja Chnadel Form Builder Blocks
author: Ninja

sections.description:
The Ninja Chnadel Form Builder Blocks block is a powerful tool for creating custom forms directly in the block editor. It includes comprehensive entry storage and management capabilities.

Core Features:
– Visual Ninja Chnadel Form Builder Blocks with drag-and-drop interface
– All standard input types (text, email, textarea, select, radio, checkbox, file upload, etc.)
– Pre-built form templates for common use cases
– Real-time form preview

Entry Storage & Management:
– Automatic database storage of all form submissions
– Admin dashboard for viewing and managing entries
– Entry status tracking (read/unread)
– Bulk actions for entry management
– Search and filter capabilities
– Export entries in CSV or JSON format
– Statistics and analytics overview

Validation & Security:
– Frontend validation with instant feedback
– Backend validation for security
– Honeypot spam protection
– Accessibility compliance (WCAG 2.1 AA)
– File upload validation and security

Advanced Features:
– Custom success/error messages
– Multiple recipient email addresses
– Custom endpoint configuration
– Drag-and-drop file uploads
– Conditional field logic
– Email notifications with entry details
– Admin notifications for new submissions

Templates Included:
– Contact Form
– Newsletter Signup
– Event Registration
– Job Application
– Feedback Survey
– Support Request

Security

This plugin follows WordPress security best practices:
– All user inputs are sanitized and validated
– Form entries are stored securely in the database
– File uploads are restricted and validated
– Honeypot protection against spam
– Nonce verification for form submissions
– SQL injection protection
– Admin capability checks for entry management
– Secure export functionality

Privacy

This plugin stores form submission data in your WordPress database, including:
– Form field data as submitted by users
– IP addresses of submitters
– User agent information
– Submission timestamps

No data is sent to external services unless you configure custom endpoints. All stored data can be viewed, managed, and exported from the WordPress admin panel.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/form-builder directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Add the “Ninja Chnadel Form Builder Blocks” block to any post or page
  4. Choose a template or build your custom form
  5. Configure validation and submission settings
  6. View form entries in the admin panel under “Form Entries”
sections.faq:
What input types are supported?

All standard HTML5 input types: text, email, tel, url, password, number, date, time, color, file, textarea, select, radio buttons, checkboxes, and hidden fields.

Where are form entries stored?

All form submissions are automatically stored in a dedicated database table. You can view, filter, export, and manage entries from the WordPress admin panel.

Can I export form entries?

Yes! You can export entries in CSV or JSON format. The export feature includes filtering options by form, status, and date range.

Is the form secure?

Yes! The block includes honeypot validation, backend validation, file upload security, and follows WordPress security best practices.

Can I customize the styling?

Absolutely! The block provides styling options in the editor, and you can add custom CSS for advanced customization.

Does it work with contact form plugins?

The Ninja Chnadel Form Builder Blocks is standalone and doesn’t require other plugins. It handles form processing natively with WordPress and stores all entries in the database.

How do I view form submissions?

After activation, you’ll see a “Form Entries” menu in your WordPress admin. This provides a complete dashboard for managing all form submissions.

Can I get email notifications?

Yes! You can configure multiple email recipients to receive notifications when forms are submitted. The emails include all form data and a link to view all entries.
